# Sudipto Kumar

> Personal portfolio of Sudipto Kumar, a BBA student specializing in Finance and Banking at Patuakhali Science and Technology University (PSTU), Bangladesh. He builds web apps, AI-assisted workflows, digital products and Telegram automation systems, and is Co-Director of Marketing & Branding at Finance Club PSTU.

Canonical site: https://sudiptokumar.vercel.app/ (single-page portfolio).

## Projects
- [Campus Duty](https://campusduty.vercel.app/): student productivity web app (TypeScript)
- [LetterShare](https://shareletter.vercel.app/): full-stack Next.js social platform (Firebase)
- [DocFlow](https://github.com/SudiptoKumar/DocFlow): native Android Markdown editor (Kotlin)
- [StudyMart BD](https://studymartbd.vercel.app/): single-owner digital product e-shop (Next.js)
- [Newsroom Automation](https://t.me/NewsroomHQ): 14-bot Python news network on GitHub Actions
- [WORKSHOP Automation](https://github.com/SudiptoKumar/WORKSHOP-): workshop management system (Apps Script)
- [Class Announcement](https://finanacecr.netlify.app): class announcement web app
- Study Campus OS: AI-assisted study workflow (no public link)
